# nomatron_service_account_token (Ephemeral Resource)

Mint and return a fresh Nomatron service account token without storing it in Terraform state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
ephemeral "nomatron_service_account_token" "example" {
  service_account_id = nomatron_service_account.example.id
  name               = "terraform"
  expires_at         = "2026-12-31T23:59:59Z"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `service_account_id` (String) Service account ID to mint a token for.

### Optional

- `expires_at` (String) Optional RFC3339 expiration timestamp for the minted token.
- `name` (String) Optional display name for the minted token.

### Read-Only

- `token` (String, Sensitive) The newly minted raw token.
- `token_id` (String) The minted token ID.
- `token_prefix` (String) Prefix for the minted token.
